title: Two Sum
key_pattern: Hash map of value -> index (complement lookup)
statement: Given an integer array and a target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target.
edge_case: The same element cannot be used twice; duplicates like [3,3] with target 6.
follow_up_prompt: What if the array is sorted and you must use O(1) extra space?

title: Product of Array Except Self
key_pattern: Prefix and suffix products
statement: Return an array where each position holds the product of every other element, without using division.
edge_case: One zero vs. two or more zeros in the input.
follow_up_prompt: What if the array is streamed and too large to hold in memory twice?

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
key_pattern: Prefix sum + hash map of counts
statement: Count the contiguous subarrays whose elements sum to exactly k.
edge_case: Negative numbers break sliding window; seed the map with {0: 1}.
follow_up_prompt: What if the input is an infinite stream and you must report the count so far?

title: Group Anagrams
key_pattern: Canonical key (sorted string or 26-count tuple)
statement: Group a list of strings so that words which are anagrams of each other end up together.
edge_case: Empty strings and Unicode characters beyond a-z.
follow_up_prompt: What if there are 10^9 words spread across many machines?

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
key_pattern: Hash set, only start counting at sequence heads
statement: Find the length of the longest run of consecutive integers in an unsorted array in linear time.
edge_case: Duplicates and negative numbers.
follow_up_prompt: What if numbers arrive one at a time and you must answer after each insert?

title: Daily Temperatures
key_pattern: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices
statement: For each day, return how many days you must wait until a warmer temperature (0 if never).
edge_case: Equal temperatures do not count as warmer.
follow_up_prompt: What if the series is a live feed and answers can be emitted late?

title: Valid Parentheses
key_pattern: Stack of opening brackets
statement: Decide if a string of brackets ()[]{} is properly opened and closed in the right order.
edge_case: String starting with a closing bracket; odd length.
follow_up_prompt: What if there is only one bracket type and you must use O(1) space?

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
key_pattern: Binary search: identify the sorted half
statement: Find a target in a sorted array that was rotated at an unknown pivot, in logarithmic time.
edge_case: Array not rotated at all; array of length 1.
follow_up_prompt: What if duplicates are allowed? What is the worst case then?

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
key_pattern: Binary search on the partition of the smaller array
statement: Find the median of two sorted arrays in logarithmic time.
edge_case: One array empty; total length even vs. odd.
follow_up_prompt: What if there are K sorted arrays on K different machines?

title: Koko Eating Bananas
key_pattern: Binary search on the answer (monotonic predicate)
statement: Find the minimum eating speed that lets Koko finish all banana piles within h hours.
edge_case: h equal to the number of piles; very large pile sizes (overflow in hours sum).
follow_up_prompt: What if piles are added while she is eating?

title: Basic Calculator
key_pattern: Stack of (result, sign) for parentheses
statement: Evaluate a string expression with +, -, parentheses and spaces, without using eval.
edge_case: Unary minus like '-(2+3)'; multi-digit numbers.
follow_up_prompt: How would you add * and / with correct precedence?

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
key_pattern: Monotonic increasing stack with sentinel
statement: Given bar heights of a histogram, find the area of the largest rectangle.
edge_case: All equal heights; strictly increasing heights (flush the stack at the end).
follow_up_prompt: How does this extend to the maximal rectangle of 1s in a binary matrix?

title: 3Sum
key_pattern: Sort + converging two pointers per anchor
statement: Return all unique triplets in the array that sum to zero.
edge_case: Skipping duplicates for the anchor and both pointers.
follow_up_prompt: Generalise to kSum. What is the complexity?

title: Container With Most Water
key_pattern: Converging pointers, move the shorter wall
statement: Pick two vertical lines that together with the x-axis hold the most water.
edge_case: Equal heights at both pointers: either move is safe.
follow_up_prompt: Prove why moving the taller wall can never help.

title: Trapping Rain Water
key_pattern: Two pointers with running left/right max
statement: Compute how much rain water is trapped between bars of given heights.
edge_case: Fewer than 3 bars traps nothing.
follow_up_prompt: What about the 2D version (Trapping Rain Water II)?

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
key_pattern: Variable window + last-seen index map
statement: Find the length of the longest substring that has no repeated characters.
edge_case: Last-seen index lies before the window start (do not move left backwards).
follow_up_prompt: What if at most K repeats per character are allowed?

title: Minimum Window Substring
key_pattern: Sliding window with need/have counters
statement: Find the smallest substring of s that contains every character of t (with multiplicity).
edge_case: t longer than s; repeated characters in t.
follow_up_prompt: What if s is a stream and you must report the best window so far?

title: Sliding Window Maximum
key_pattern: Monotonic deque of indices
statement: Return the maximum of every contiguous window of size k.
edge_case: k == 1 and k == n; evict indices that fall out of the window.
follow_up_prompt: What if you also need the median of every window?

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
key_pattern: Window valid while len - maxFreq <= k
statement: Replace at most k characters to get the longest substring of one repeated letter.
edge_case: Why maxFreq never needs to decrease.
follow_up_prompt: What if the alphabet is all of Unicode?

title: Fruit Into Baskets
key_pattern: Longest window with at most 2 distinct values
statement: Pick the longest contiguous run of trees containing at most two fruit types.
edge_case: All trees the same type.
follow_up_prompt: Generalise to at most K distinct types.

title: Subarrays with K Different Integers
key_pattern: exactly(K) = atMost(K) - atMost(K-1)
statement: Count subarrays that contain exactly k distinct integers.
edge_case: k larger than the number of distinct values.
follow_up_prompt: Why can a single window not count 'exactly K' directly?

title: Merge Intervals
key_pattern: Sort by start, merge overlaps
statement: Merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping result.
edge_case: Touching intervals like [1,4] and [4,5] should merge.
follow_up_prompt: What if intervals arrive one by one and you must keep the merged set?

title: Insert Interval
key_pattern: Three-phase scan: before, overlap, after
statement: Insert a new interval into a sorted list of non-overlapping intervals, merging if needed.
edge_case: New interval before all or after all existing intervals.
follow_up_prompt: Do it with binary search when the list is huge.

title: Meeting Rooms II
key_pattern: Min-heap of end times or sweep line
statement: Given meeting time intervals, find the minimum number of conference rooms required.
edge_case: A meeting ending exactly when another starts frees the room.
follow_up_prompt: What if you must also return which room each meeting uses?

title: Employee Free Time
key_pattern: Merge sorted interval lists with a heap
statement: Given each employee's sorted working intervals, return the finite common free time slots.
edge_case: Ignore infinite gaps before the first and after the last interval.
follow_up_prompt: What if schedules live in different time zones and services?

title: Non-overlapping Intervals
key_pattern: Greedy: sort by end, keep earliest finishing
statement: Find the minimum number of intervals to remove so the rest do not overlap.
edge_case: Touching endpoints are not overlapping.
follow_up_prompt: Prove why sorting by end (not start) is optimal.

title: Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling
key_pattern: Sort by end + DP with binary search
statement: Choose non-overlapping jobs (start, end, profit) to maximise total profit.
edge_case: A job may start exactly when another ends.
follow_up_prompt: What if you have K machines instead of one?

title: Meeting Rooms III
key_pattern: Sort by start; min-heap of free room ids + min-heap of (end, room)
time_target: O(M log M + M log N)
statement: n rooms are numbered 0..n-1. Each meeting [start, end) goes to the lowest-numbered free room, or waits for the earliest room to free up and keeps its duration. Return the room that hosted the most meetings.
edge_case: A delayed meeting keeps its original duration; ties on end time go to the lowest room id.
follow_up_prompt: What if rooms have different capacities and meetings have sizes?

title: Merge k Sorted Lists
key_pattern: Min-heap of list heads
statement: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
edge_case: Some lists empty; k == 0.
follow_up_prompt: What if each list lives on a different machine and memory is 64MB?

title: Top K Frequent Elements
key_pattern: Count + size-K min-heap (or bucket sort)
statement: Return the k most frequent elements.
edge_case: Ties in frequency; k equal to the number of distinct values.
follow_up_prompt: What if the input is a stream of 10^9 events (heavy hitters / count-min sketch)?

title: Find Median from Data Stream
key_pattern: Two heaps: max-heap low half, min-heap high half
statement: Design a structure that supports adding numbers and returning the running median.
edge_case: Even count returns the average of the two middles.
follow_up_prompt: What if 99% of numbers are in [0,100]?

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
key_pattern: Size-K min-heap or quickselect
statement: Return the k-th largest element in an unsorted array.
edge_case: Duplicates count separately.
follow_up_prompt: Average vs. worst case of quickselect; how to defend against the worst case?

title: Car Pooling
key_pattern: Sort by pickup + min-heap of drop-offs (or difference array)
statement: A car with a fixed capacity only drives east. Given trips [passengers, from, to], decide if it can complete every trip without exceeding capacity.
edge_case: Drop-offs at a location happen before pick-ups at the same location.
follow_up_prompt: What if locations go up to 10^9 and trips arrive as a stream?

title: Task Scheduler
key_pattern: Greedy by max frequency (formula or heap)
statement: Find the minimum time units to run tasks when identical tasks need n idle units between them.
edge_case: n == 0; several tasks share the max frequency.
follow_up_prompt: Return the actual schedule, not just its length.

title: Reorganize String
key_pattern: Max-heap, place most frequent char not equal to last
statement: Rearrange a string so no two adjacent characters are equal, or return empty if impossible.
edge_case: Impossible when maxFreq > (n + 1) / 2.
follow_up_prompt: Generalise to distance K apart.

title: Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums
key_pattern: Min-heap frontier over index pairs (seed first column, expand j+1)
statement: Given two sorted arrays and k, return the k pairs (one element from each array) with the smallest sums.
edge_case: k larger than len(a) * len(b); pushing the same pair twice.
follow_up_prompt: What if both arrays are huge sorted files on disk?

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
key_pattern: Post-order: return the node found in each subtree
statement: Find the lowest common ancestor of two nodes in a binary tree.
edge_case: One node is an ancestor of the other.
follow_up_prompt: What if nodes have parent pointers? What if p or q may be missing?

title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
key_pattern: Pre-order with null markers
statement: Design encode/decode functions that turn a binary tree into a string and back.
edge_case: Negative and multi-digit values; empty tree.
follow_up_prompt: How would you make the encoding compact for a near-complete tree?

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
key_pattern: DFS returning best downward gain, update global
statement: Find the maximum sum of any path between two nodes in a binary tree.
edge_case: All negative values: answer is the largest single node.
follow_up_prompt: Return the path itself, not just the sum.

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
key_pattern: DFS with (low, high) bounds or in-order
statement: Decide whether a binary tree is a valid binary search tree.
edge_case: Duplicates; values at integer limits.
follow_up_prompt: Do it iteratively with O(1) extra space (Morris traversal).

title: Binary Tree Right Side View
key_pattern: BFS level order, take the last node per level
statement: Return the values visible when looking at a binary tree from the right side.
edge_case: Left subtree deeper than the right one.
follow_up_prompt: Return both the left and right views in one pass.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
key_pattern: In-order traversal with counter
statement: Return the k-th smallest value in a binary search tree.
edge_case: k equal to the number of nodes.
follow_up_prompt: What if the BST is modified often and you query often?

title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
key_pattern: Recursion with inorder index map
statement: Rebuild a binary tree given its pre-order and in-order traversals.
edge_case: Skewed tree causing deep recursion.
follow_up_prompt: Why can pre-order + post-order not uniquely rebuild a tree?

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
key_pattern: DFS height, update global left + right
statement: Return the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a binary tree.
edge_case: Path need not pass through the root.
follow_up_prompt: Solve the same for an n-ary tree.

title: Vertical Order Traversal of a Binary Tree
key_pattern: DFS with (col, row, val) then sort
statement: Return node values grouped by column, sorted by row then value within a column.
edge_case: Two nodes at the same row and column: sort by value.
follow_up_prompt: How would you avoid the global sort?

title: All Nodes Distance K in Binary Tree
key_pattern: Convert to graph (parent map) + BFS
statement: Return all nodes exactly distance k from a target node.
edge_case: k == 0 returns the target itself.
follow_up_prompt: Answer many (target, k) queries efficiently.

title: Number of Islands
key_pattern: DFS/BFS flood fill
statement: Count islands of '1's connected horizontally or vertically in a grid.
edge_case: Empty grid; recursion depth on a huge island.
follow_up_prompt: What if land is added one cell at a time (Number of Islands II, union-find)?

title: Course Schedule
key_pattern: Cycle detection (Kahn or 3-colour DFS)
statement: Decide if all courses can be finished given prerequisite pairs.
edge_case: Self-dependency; disconnected components.
follow_up_prompt: Return the minimum number of semesters needed.

title: Course Schedule II
key_pattern: Topological sort (Kahn's algorithm)
statement: Return an order in which to take all courses, or empty if impossible.
edge_case: Cycle detection: output shorter than V.
follow_up_prompt: What if prerequisites change frequently?

title: Word Ladder
key_pattern: BFS over wildcard pattern buckets
statement: Find the shortest transformation length from begin to end word, changing one letter at a time via a word list.
edge_case: End word missing from the list.
follow_up_prompt: Bidirectional BFS: why is it faster?

title: Alien Dictionary
key_pattern: Build edges from adjacent words, topological sort
statement: Given words sorted in an unknown alphabet, derive a valid order of its letters.
edge_case: Prefix case like ['abc', 'ab'] is invalid.
follow_up_prompt: Return all valid orders, or detect if the order is unique.

title: Network Delay Time
key_pattern: Dijkstra with a min-heap
statement: Find how long it takes a signal from node k to reach all nodes, or -1.
edge_case: Unreachable nodes; stale heap entries.
follow_up_prompt: What if edge weights can be negative?

title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
key_pattern: Bellman-Ford limited to K+1 rounds (or BFS by stops)
statement: Find the cheapest price from src to dst with at most k stops.
edge_case: Copy distances per round to avoid using more stops.
follow_up_prompt: Why does plain Dijkstra fail with the stop limit?

title: Accounts Merge
key_pattern: Union-find on emails
statement: Merge accounts that share at least one email address.
edge_case: Same name does not imply the same person.
follow_up_prompt: What if accounts live in shards across data centres?

title: Evaluate Division
key_pattern: Weighted graph BFS/DFS or weighted union-find
statement: Given equations like a/b = 2.0, answer queries such as a/c.
edge_case: Unknown variables; x/x for a known x is 1.0.
follow_up_prompt: Answer 10^6 queries quickly (weighted union-find with path compression).

title: Bus Routes
key_pattern: BFS where nodes are bus routes (stop -> routes index)
statement: Given bus routes as lists of stops, return the fewest buses needed to travel from a source stop to a target stop, or -1.
edge_case: source == target needs 0 buses; visit each route only once.
follow_up_prompt: What if you must minimise total travel time with a penalty per transfer?

title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
key_pattern: DFS + memoisation (DAG longest path)
statement: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing path in a matrix (4 directions).
edge_case: Equal neighbours are not increasing.
follow_up_prompt: Return the path itself; solve with topological order instead of recursion.

title: Rotting Oranges
key_pattern: Multi-source BFS
statement: Return minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if impossible.
edge_case: No fresh oranges at all returns 0.
follow_up_prompt: What if rot spreads with different speeds per cell?

title: Number of Provinces
key_pattern: Union-find (or DFS) over the adjacency matrix
statement: Given an n x n matrix of direct connections between cities, count the groups of connected cities.
edge_case: Diagonal self-connections; an isolated city is its own province.
follow_up_prompt: What if connections are added and removed over time?

title: Coin Change
key_pattern: Unbounded knapsack, min coins
statement: Find the fewest coins needed to make an amount, or -1.
edge_case: Amount 0 returns 0; unreachable amounts.
follow_up_prompt: Count the number of ways instead (Coin Change II). Loop order?

title: Edit Distance
key_pattern: 2D DP over prefixes
statement: Find the minimum insert/delete/replace operations to convert one word into another.
edge_case: One string empty.
follow_up_prompt: Reconstruct the actual edit script.

title: Decode Ways
key_pattern: 1D DP with one- and two-digit lookback
statement: Count how many ways a digit string can be decoded where 'A'=1 ... 'Z'=26.
edge_case: Zeros: '0', '06', '100' have no valid decoding.
follow_up_prompt: Add a '*' wildcard digit (Decode Ways II).

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
key_pattern: Patience sorting tails + binary search
statement: Return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
edge_case: Equal values do not extend the sequence.
follow_up_prompt: Reconstruct one LIS; count all LIS.

title: Word Break
key_pattern: DP over prefixes with a word set
statement: Decide if a string can be split into a sequence of dictionary words.
edge_case: Reusing words is allowed.
follow_up_prompt: Return all sentences (Word Break II); what blows up?

title: Regular Expression Matching
key_pattern: 2D DP on text/pattern prefixes
statement: Implement regex matching with '.' and '*' covering the entire string.
edge_case: Patterns like 'a*' matching empty; leading '*' is invalid.
follow_up_prompt: Add '+' and '?' operators.

title: Burst Balloons
key_pattern: Interval DP: choose the last balloon to burst
statement: Burst balloons to maximise coins where bursting i gives nums[left]*nums[i]*nums[right].
edge_case: Pad with 1 on both ends.
follow_up_prompt: Why does choosing the first balloon to burst not work?

title: House Robber
key_pattern: 1D DP: rob or skip
statement: Maximise money robbed from houses in a line without robbing two adjacent houses.
edge_case: Single house.
follow_up_prompt: Houses in a circle (House Robber II) or a tree (III).

title: Unique Paths
key_pattern: Grid DP (or combinatorics)
statement: Count the paths from top-left to bottom-right moving only right or down.
edge_case: 1 x N grid has exactly one path.
follow_up_prompt: Add obstacles; what if the grid is 10^5 x 10^5?

title: Longest Common Subsequence
key_pattern: 2D DP on prefixes
statement: Return the length of the longest common subsequence of two strings.
edge_case: No common characters returns 0.
follow_up_prompt: Diff two 1GB files: what changes (Hirschberg / Myers)?

title: LRU Cache
key_pattern: Hash map + doubly linked list
statement: Design a cache with get and put in O(1) that evicts the least recently used key.
edge_case: Updating an existing key must refresh its recency.
follow_up_prompt: Make it thread-safe; make it distributed across nodes.

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
key_pattern: Trie nodes with children map + end flag
statement: Implement insert, search and startsWith for a prefix tree.
edge_case: Prefix that is also a full word.
follow_up_prompt: Add delete; compress the trie (radix tree).

title: Word Search II
key_pattern: Trie + backtracking DFS with pruning
statement: Find all dictionary words that can be formed by adjacent letters in a board.
edge_case: Same word found twice; remove found words from the trie.
follow_up_prompt: What if the dictionary has 10^6 words and the board is huge?

title: Time Based Key-Value Store
key_pattern: Map of key -> sorted (time, value) + binary search
statement: Design set(key, value, t) and get(key, t) that returns the value with the largest time <= t.
edge_case: Query time earlier than every set returns empty.
follow_up_prompt: What if writes arrive out of order? Persist to disk?

title: Design Hit Counter
key_pattern: Circular buffer of 300 (time, count) buckets
statement: Count hits in the past 5 minutes with hit(t) and getHits(t).
edge_case: Many hits in the same second.
follow_up_prompt: Millions of hits per second across many servers.

title: N-Queens
key_pattern: Backtracking with column and diagonal sets
statement: Place n queens on an n x n board so none attack each other; return all boards.
edge_case: n = 2 and n = 3 have no solutions.
follow_up_prompt: Return only the count; use bitmasks.
